question: MN is the diameter of a circle with center O. P and S are two points situated on the circumference of the circle on either side of MN such that ∠PMN = 50° and ∠MNS = 35°. What will be the measure of the degree of difference between ∠PMS and ∠PNS?
solution:
**Given:**

MN is the diameter of a circle with center O.

 ∠PMN = 50° and ∠MNS = 35°.

**Calculation: **

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42b712264d49bdfe76aa86fb41718000eae4838fa1f9a0cdf7504b6af99b77ea.png] 

∠P = 90° as an angle in a semi-circle.

So, ∠PNM = 90° - 50° = 40°

Similarly ∠S = 90° as an angle in semi-circle.

So, ∠SMN = 90° - 35° = 55°

So ∠PMS = 50° + 55° = 105° and ∠PNS = 40° + 35° = 75°

The difference between ∠PMS and ∠PNS is 

⇒ 105° - 75° = 30° 

**∴ The correct option is 1**
